# Constants

```{r}
true_N <- 1282

points_or_lines = "line"

phase_grid_val <- 100

trunc_dist <- 40
scale_parameter <- 15
design_spacing <- 400

density_grid_spacing <- 100

outer_loop_reps <- 1
bootstrap_reps <- 1500

ten_mil_est <- mcse_10M |>
  arrange(scenario, density_scenario) |>
  filter(scenario == 8 & transect == "line") # change this each run

green_lines <- tibble(density = c("Density 1", "Density 2", 
                                   "Density 3", "Density 4"),
                      vals = ten_mil_est$mc_se)
```

# Replicating Fewster Triangle regions

```{r}
# Define a right triangle with 10000m axes
triangle_coords <- matrix(c(
  10000, 10000, 
  10000, 0, 
  0, 0, 
  10000, 10000       
), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)

region <- st_polygon(list(triangle_coords)) |> 
  st_sfc() |> 
  st_sf(geometry = _)

region <- make_region(region_sf = region)

plot(region)
```

# 1. Extract the spatial objects and distance data from your custom lists
pop_df <- test_sim_truth$population@population 
trans_sf <- test_survey$transects@samplers

# Filter out empty transects (NAs) from the distance data
obs_df <- test_survey$dist_data |> 
  filter(!is.na(distance))

# 2. Flag detected animals by matching their exact spatial coordinates
# Since dsims overrides the 'object' ID with a sequential observation index,
# we cross-reference the x and y coordinates to find the exact animals.
pop_sf <- pop_df |> 
  mutate(
    Status = if_else(
      paste0(x, "_", y) %in% paste0(obs_df$x, "_", obs_df$y), 
      "Detected", 
      "Missed"
    )
  ) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = st_crs(test_region@region))

# 3. Build the plot
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = test_region@region, fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = trans_sf, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_sf(data = pop_sf, aes(color = Status), size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Detected" = "red", "Missed" = "grey80")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Simulated Survey with Detections",
    subtitle = paste("Detected:", nrow(obs_df), "of", nrow(pop_sf)),
    color = "Animal Status"
  )

# Main Simulation block

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
num_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 2)
plan(multisession, workers = num_cores)

num_scenarios <- length(densities)

message(sprintf("Starting parallel simulation across %d workers...", num_cores))

all_runs <- future_map(1:outer_loop_reps, function(b) {

  inner_results <- map(seq_along(densities), function(i) {

    sim_pop <- generate_simulated_pop(
      region = region,
      density_true = densities[[i]]
    )

    survey_results <- survey_data(
      region = region,
      realized_population = sim_pop$population,
      transect_type = points_or_lines,
      spacing = design_spacing,
      truncation = trunc_dist
    )
    
    n_det <- nrow(survey_results$obsdata)

    # Pre-build a baseline NA row. If models fail, we instantly return this.
    res_row <- tibble(
      iteration = b, density = paste("Density", i),
      N_hat = NA_real_, n_detections = n_det, true_analytic_se = NA_real_,
      se_R2 = NA_real_, se_R3 = NA_real_, se_S1 = NA_real_, se_S2 = NA_real_,
      se_O1 = NA_real_, se_O2 = NA_real_, se_P2 = NA_real_, se_P3 = NA_real_,
      se_striplet = NA_real_, se_boxlet = NA_real_, se_boot_std = NA_real_, se_boot_disc = NA_real_
    )
    
    # Pre-build padding for the convergence plot in case this iteration fails
    boot_padding <- if (b == outer_loop_reps) list(Standard = rep(NA_real_, bootstrap_reps), Discrete = rep(NA_real_, bootstrap_reps)) else NULL

    # 2. Fit ds() - Circuit Breaker 1
    ds_results <- try(fit_ds(
      region = region,
      dist_data = survey_results$dist_data,
      obsdata = survey_results$obsdata,
      segdata = survey_results$segdata,
      transect_type = points_or_lines,
      truncation = trunc_dist,
      spacing = design_spacing
    ), silent = TRUE)

    # If ds() crashes (too few detections), abort and jump to next iteration
    if (inherits(ds_results, "try-error") || is.null(ds_results)) {
      return(list(row = res_row, bootstraps = boot_padding))
    }

    # If ds() succeeds, lock in EVERYTHING we know so far immediately!
    res_row$N_hat <- ds_results$N_hat
    res_row$se_R2 <- ds_results$analytical_variances$se_N_R2 %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_R3 <- ds_results$analytical_variances$se_N_R3 %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_S1 <- ds_results$analytical_variances$se_N_S1 %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_S2 <- ds_results$analytical_variances$se_N_S2 %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_O1 <- ds_results$analytical_variances$se_N_O1 %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_O2 <- ds_results$analytical_variances$se_N_O2 %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_P2 <- ds_results$analytical_variances$se_N_P2 %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_P3 <- ds_results$analytical_variances$se_N_P3 %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_P4 <- ds_results$analytical_variances$se_N_P4 %||% NA_real_

    # 3. Fit dsm() - Circuit Breaker 2
    dsm_results <- try(fit_dsm_and_surface(
      obsdata = survey_results$obsdata,
      segdata = survey_results$segdata,
      ds_model = ds_results$ds_model,
      region = region,
      N_hat = ds_results$N_hat,
      transect_type = points_or_lines,
      x_space = density_grid_spacing,
      y_space = density_grid_spacing
    ), silent = TRUE)

    # If dsm() crashes, abort! (But now res_row safely contains N_hat, P2, and P3!)
    if (inherits(dsm_results, "try-error") || is.null(dsm_results)) {
      return(list(row = res_row, bootstraps = boot_padding))
    }

    # 4. If we reach here, models fit perfectly. Run analytical and bootstrap math normally.
    # analytical_se <- analytic_se(
    #   region = region,
    #   dsm_model = dsm_results$dsm,
    #   ds_results = ds_results,
    #   transect_type = points_or_lines,
    #   spacing = design_spacing,
    #   truncation = trunc_dist,
    #   phase_grid = phase_grid_val
    # )

    spatial_variances <- striplet_boxlet(
      region = region,
      segdata = survey_results$segdata,
      dsm_model = dsm_results$dsm,
      dsm_surface = dsm_results$density_surface,
      ds_results = ds_results,
      transect_type = points_or_lines,
      spacing = design_spacing,
      truncation = trunc_dist
    )

    standard <- get_bootstrap(
      region = region,
      population_description = dsm_results$population_description,
      sigma_hat = ds_results$sigma_hat,
      transect_type = points_or_lines,
      reps = bootstrap_reps
    )

    disc_density <- get_bootstrap_disc_density(
      region = region,
      population_description = dsm_results$population_description,
      sigma_hat = ds_results$sigma_hat,
      transect_type = points_or_lines,
      reps = bootstrap_reps
    )

    # Safely update the remaining fields
    # res_row$true_analytic_se <- analytical_se$se
    res_row$se_striplet <- spatial_variances$se_N_striplet %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_boxlet <- spatial_variances$se_N_boxlet %||% NA_real_
    res_row$se_boot_std <- sd(standard$N_hat, na.rm = TRUE)
    res_row$se_boot_disc <- sd(disc_density$N_hat, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Safely return row and arrays for plotting
    list(
      row = res_row,
      bootstraps = if (b == outer_loop_reps) {
        list(Standard = standard$N_hat, 
             Discrete = disc_density$N_hat)
      } else NULL
    )

  })

  list(
    summary = map_dfr(inner_results, "row"),
    bootstraps = map(inner_results, "bootstraps")
  )

}, .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE))

sim_results <- map_dfr(all_runs, "summary")
last_rep_bootstraps <- all_runs[[outer_loop_reps]]$bootstraps

plan(sequential)
```

## MC convergence plot

```{r}
# Plotting Monte Carlo convergence

# Custom function to calculate cumulative SD
cum_sd <- function(x, expected_length = bootstrap_reps) {
  # If the array is empty, too short, or all NAs (model failed), return appropriately sized NAs
  if (length(x) < 2 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, expected_length - 1))
  }

  # Start from 2 because you can't get an SD of a single number
  sapply(25:length(x), function(j) sd(x[1:j], na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Build plot data dynamically by looping through the saved list of the last iteration
plot_data <- bind_rows(lapply(1:num_scenarios, function(i) {

  boot_std <- last_rep_bootstraps[[i]]$Standard
  boot_disc <- last_rep_bootstraps[[i]]$Discrete

  tibble(
    replicate = 25:bootstrap_reps,
    Density = paste("Density", i),
    Standard = cum_sd(boot_std),
    Discrete = cum_sd(boot_disc)
) |>
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(Standard, Discrete), 
      names_to = "Method",
      values_to = "Running_SD"
    )
}))

# Generate the facet plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = replicate, y = Running_SD, color = Method)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8, linewidth = 1) +
  # geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 144), color = "green") +
  facet_wrap(~Density, scales = "free_y") + # 'free_y' allows each density to have its own y-axis scale
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Standard" = "blue", "Discrete" = "red")) +
  labs(
    title = "Line Transect Bootstrap Convergence (Running SD)",
    # subtitle = paste("Recorded from outer loop iteration", outer_loop_reps),
    x = "Bootstrap Replicate",
    y = "Cumulative Standard Deviation",
    color = "Bootstrap Method"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
saveRDS(plot_data, file = here::here("Long_sim_results", "convergence_results_pts_1500.rds"))
ggsave(filename = here::here("Long_sim_results", "convergence_results_1500_plot.png"))
```


## Summary table

```{r}
sim_summary <- sim_results |>
  group_by(density) |>
  summarize(
    mean_N_hat = mean(N_hat, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_dets = mean(n_detections, na.rm = TRUE),
    true_SE = sd(N_hat, na.rm = TRUE),
    # mean_analytic_se = mean(true_analytic_se, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_R2 = mean(se_R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_R3 = mean(se_R3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_S1 = mean(se_S1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_S2 = mean(se_S2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_O1 = mean(se_O1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_O2 = mean(se_O2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_P2 = mean(se_P2, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_P3 = mean(se_P3, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_P4 = mean(se_P4, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_striplet = mean(se_striplet, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_boxlet = mean(se_boxlet, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_se_boot_std = mean(se_boot_std, na.rm = TRUE),
    # mean_se_boot_disc = mean(se_boot_disc, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(sim_summary) |>
  kable(digits = 1)
```

## Summary plot

```{r}
desired_order <- c(
  "se_R2", "se_R3", "se_S1", "se_S2", "se_O1", "se_O2",
  "se_P2", "se_P3", "se_P4", "se_striplet", "se_boxlet",
  "se_boot_std"
)

plot_dat <- sim_results |>
  mutate(density = factor(density, levels = unique(density))) |>
  group_by(density) |>
  mutate(true_ish_se = sd(N_hat, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = any_of(desired_order),
    names_to = "name",
    values_to = "value",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = desired_order)) 

ggplot(plot_dat, aes(x = name, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(data = green_lines, aes(yintercept = vals), color = "green") +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = true_ish_se), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ density, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x", drop = FALSE) + 
  labs(
    title = "Variance Estimator Performance across Realizations",
    subtitle = "Red Dashed = Empirical True SE | Green Solid = 10M Bootstrapped SE",
    x = "Estimator Type",
    y = "Estimated Standard Error"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
